sourceNote: v2 OFFICIAL: rates transcribed from WotC's own 'Collecting MAGIC: THE GATHERING—FINAL FANTASY' article. Rare/mythic slot: default rare 80%, default mythic 10%, borderless rare 8%, borderless mythic 1% (the ~1% FINAL FANTASY-artist series is left unmodelled and display-only — a 1% group is not worth a misclassification). One third of Play Boosters carry a FINAL FANTASY: Through the Ages card, split uncommon 63.25% / rare 29.75% / mythic 7% per the article — modelled as its own three tiers at NON-foil play prices. The traditional-foil slot and its 1.85% woodblock group are NOT modelled (foils excluded from Play EV site-wide), so EV still understates slightly. Uniform-within-tier remains the per-card assumption inside each pool. Pool rule: special tiers contain ONLY prints that exist non-foil (Collector-exclusive foil-only variants stay display-only), priced at non-foil market — a first pass that let foil prices in briefly read +44% on this box and was corrected before shipping.
